context: Directions Directions: Installation 1. Remove the cap and seal of the HAIR POWDER and HAIR TONIC. 2. Pour 2g HAIR POWDER into 100mL HAIR TONIC bottle. 3. Install enclosed mist pump and close tightly. 4. Shake HAIR TONIC bottle to mix contents well.
